summary: MEDIUM priority APPLIANCE issue identified in property. STANDARD resolution recommended.

summary: MEDIUM priority HVAC issue identified in property. STANDARD resolution recommended.

Check external drainage pipe for visible blockages or refrigerant icing.

summary: MEDIUM priority PLUMBING issue identified in property. STANDARD resolution recommended.

Avoid using connected drainage until lines are inspected for backpressure.
